database: Omitted; the dataset is too small to need one, and a local JSON file stays directly usable as context for local AI tools.
card template: Defined in application source, hand-written or assembled by the service from a declarative composition tree (D22, narrows D2) — the agent never authors component code directly either way. The tree names real react-aria-components exports; correctness comes from tsc against the library's real types, not a hand-maintained parallel schema (an earlier draft tried that and was wrong). Static trees only — a widget needing hooks or local state stays hand-written.
component library: Declared once, at dashboard initialization (D23), not through a mutation — the same reasoning as D22 applied to styling instead of structure. Letting a mutation or a card template introduce CSS ad hoc would mean re-deriving what's in bounds per call; naming one library once keeps every later styling choice checkable against a fixed, known vocabulary instead of arbitrary CSS. shadcn/ui today.
registry: A running dashboard serves its own wired-in card templates as a shadcn-compatible registry (D24), generated at request time from includedCardTemplates rather than a directory scan — the templates directory also holds a view component, tests, and in-flight assemble output that a scan would wrongly surface as items.
display-role key: Schema keys name how a value is displayed rather than what it means in a source domain, so a formatter can retarget new source data onto an existing template without new code.
react-aria-components: Preferred over the react-aria and react-stately hooks. Rebuilding the benchmark card on hooks made it longer, there is no stepper hook, and announce() is not public API. Hooks remain a per-component escape hatch where the wrappers cannot emit the markup needed.
react-aria: Not declared directly. It and react-stately are exact-pinned transitives of react-aria-components; declaring a different range installs duplicate copies and breaks context identity.
formatter: Restricted to identity, a bundled function, or a declarative spec, so formatting is never arbitrary agent-authored code.
decision records: No ADR directory. Pre-release decisions churn, and a superseded record left on disk misleads agents that grep for it. Current-state documents are edited in place instead, and reasons live here keyed by term.
templates directory: Example source data shapes live at templates/ with placeholder content. The shape is what card templates are validated against; the content is never real.
